## Goal
Every checklist carries `date_checked` and a `verification` level (`models.py:781-783`, rules in the header of `brokers/checklists.yaml:5-12`): public text may say only what a page we read supports. Nothing flags an entry whose official page was last checked long ago, although credit-freeze and IRS steps change. Add `stale_sources(cf, today, months=12) -> list[tuple[str, int]]` to `checklists.py`: `(checklist id, whole months since date_checked)` for entries older than `months`, oldest first, ties by id. It also returns entries whose `verification` is `partial` once they pass 6 months (they were not fully confirmed). Pure; the maintainer tool, doctor or release check can call it later (in-house decides).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. For a fake `ChecklistFile` with dates 2026-11-01, 2025-10-01, 2025-12-01 and today 2026-11-09, months=12: only the 2025-10-01 entry is listed (13 months); the 2025-12-01 entry (11 months) is not.
2. A `partial` entry checked 7 months ago is listed (reason `partial`); an `official_page` entry checked 7 months ago is not.
3. Month counting is whole calendar months, with end-of-month dates handled (a date on the 31st compared to a 30-day month does not raise or miscount; test 2026-01-31 vs 2026-02-28 and 2026-03-30).
4. A `date_checked` in the future is never stale and does not raise.
5. Sorted oldest first, ties by id; the function does not mutate `cf`.
6. For the real bundled file (`load()`): the function runs without error and returns a list (the test does NOT assert it is empty, so it cannot go red as time passes; it prints the count for VENDOR_STATUS.md).
7. `load()` and every existing checklist test pass unchanged; WO-246/282 tests pass.

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing (2026-11-09); re-check them.
